1 (Currently amended): An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor.

2 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

3 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

4 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

5 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

6 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

7 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

16 (Currently amended): A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type and a time that the alarm was triggered; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the alarm data includes information about whether the alarm was acknowledged. 

17 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

18 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm.

19 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm.

20 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices.
